services.title: Wedding Photography
services.shortDesc: Traditional and candid coverage of rituals, joy, and emotional moments.
services.fullDesc: Complete wedding day coverage by expert candid and traditional photographers using high-end Sony Alpha full-frame cameras and premium prime lenses.

services.title: Wedding Cinematography
services.shortDesc: 4K cinematic film, drone aerial shots, and heart-touching highlight teasers.
services.fullDesc: Transform your wedding into a silver-screen movie with multi-cam setups, gimbal stabilization, 4K HDR recording, cinematic color grading, and drone coverage.

services.title: Pre-Wedding Shoots
services.shortDesc: Romantic storytelling at scenic outdoor locations, beaches, and heritage resorts.
services.fullDesc: Celebrate your love journey with a relaxed, romantic photoshoot and music video teaser. Includes concept planning, creative props, and outfit consultation.

services.title: Engagement Photography
services.shortDesc: Capturing the ring ceremony, family blessings, and couple chemistry.
services.fullDesc: Graceful documentation of engagement ceremonies, ring exchange, family group portraits, and romantic portraits.

services.title: Birthday Photography
services.shortDesc: Cake cutting, vibrant decor, laughter, and candid memories of the celebrant.
services.fullDesc: Make birthdays unforgettable with playful candid shots, theme decor coverage, family group pictures, and exciting reels.

services.title: Baby Photography & Milestone Shoots
services.shortDesc: Gentle, creative newborn and toddler photography with cute themes and safe setups.
services.fullDesc: Preserve the innocence and precious milestones of your baby with cozy, sanitised studio setups, adorable props, and patience.

services.title: Half Saree & Traditional Functions
services.shortDesc: Rich South Indian traditions, Sreemantham, Dhoti ceremonies, and puja coverage.
services.fullDesc: Specialized coverage of South Indian traditions including Half Saree (Langa Voni) ceremonies, Dhoti ceremonies, Housewarmings (Gruhapravesam), and Poojas.

services.title: Anniversary Photography
services.shortDesc: Celebrating enduring love, milestones, and family legacy with warmth.
services.fullDesc: Special photoshoot sessions for Silver, Golden, or 1st Wedding Anniversaries, renewing memories and capturing generational family portraits.

services.title: Maternity and Family Photoshoots
services.shortDesc: Elegance of motherhood and warm bonds in indoor studio and garden settings.
services.fullDesc: Celebrate the miracle of motherhood with graceful maternity gowns, studio lighting, and affectionate family moments.

services.title: Birthday & Event Videography
services.shortDesc: High-definition video coverage with music sync, cinematic cuts, and reels.
services.fullDesc: Full HD / 4K event videography capturing guest reactions, games, dances, and memorable speeches with crystal-clear audio recording.

services.title: Outdoor Photoshoots
services.shortDesc: Golden hour portraits at picturesque beaches, lush parks, and architectural sites.
services.fullDesc: Outdoor portfolio, fashion, and lifestyle photoshoots during optimum natural lighting conditions with reflectors and off-camera flashes.

services.title: Photo Albums & Premium Printing
services.shortDesc: Flush mount photobooks, acrylic glass covers, velvet finish, and canvas wraps.
services.fullDesc: Museum-grade photo albums printed on non-tearable metallic and luster paper with 3D embossed and acrylic luxury covers designed to last generations.

services.title: Passport, Visa & ID Photos
services.shortDesc: Instant biometric photo printing according to all international visa standards.
services.fullDesc: 5-minute instant passport and visa photos adhering strictly to US, UK, Schengen, Canada, and Indian biometric specifications.

services.title: Other Custom Events & Corporate
services.shortDesc: College fests, corporate inaugurations, political rallies, and cultural galas.
services.fullDesc: Professional multi-camera and live broadcasting setup for corporate seminars, brand promotions, musical concerts, and custom private celebrations.

quotations.message: Looking for high-end cinematic crew for Haldi, Mehendi, Sangeet in Araku and Muhurtham in Vizag.

testimonials.reviewText: CHINNI DIGITALS made our wedding look like an epic cinema! The candid shots captured real emotions that we will treasure forever. Chinni garu and his crew were so patient, energetic, and professional.
We booked the Half Saree package for our daughter. The photo album quality with the acrylic cover is simply mind-blowing! All our relatives were asking who did the photography. Best studio in town!
The drone music teaser they created for our pre-wedding went viral on Instagram! Extremely creative poses, beautiful lighting, and prompt delivery. Thank you Chinni Digitals team!
